title: Cortex-FL: Agent-Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data. However, identifying collaborators, preparing training tasks, and coordinating execution and incentives hinder its practical adoption by organizations without specialized expertise. We present Cortex-FL, an agent-native FL system that enables users to express learning objectives in natural language and delegate the collaboration required to train a model. Agents translate these objectives into shared tasks, discover collaborators, and negotiate participation agreements, connecting collaboration formation with distributed training and incentive management. The architecture separates agent coordination from local execution authority, allowing owners to delegate coordination while retaining control over their data, computation, and financial commitments. translated_title: Cortex-FL：智能体中介的联邦学习协作系统
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使独立的数据拥有方能够在不集中原始数据的情况下协同训练模型。然而，识别协作者、准备训练任务、协调执行与激励机制，阻碍了缺乏专业知识的组织对联邦学习的实际采用。我们提出了Cortex-FL，一个智能体原生（agent-native）的联邦学习系统，用户只需用自然语言表达学习目标，即可将训练模型所需的协作工作委托出去。智能体会将这些目标转化为共享任务、发现潜在协作者，并协商参与协议，从而将协作的建立与分布式训练及激励管理连接起来。该架构将智能体协调与本地执行权限相分离，使数据拥有方在委托协调工作的同时，仍保留对其数据、计算和财务承诺的控制权。我们在一个四节点部署上演示了完整的工作流程。
tldr: Cortex-FL是一个智能体原生的联邦学习系统，用户只需用自然语言表达学习目标，智能体即可自动完成协作者发现、任务生成、协议协商、分布式训练与激励管理，并通过将协调与本地执行权限分离来保障数据拥有方的控制权。
en_tdlr: Cortex-FL is an agent-native federated learning system where users express objectives in natural language and agents automatically handle collaborator discovery, task creation, agreement negotiation, and incentive management, while separating agent coordination from local execution authority to preserve owner control over data, computation, and financial commitments.
